name: National Overseas Scholarship for SC Candidates
offeredBy: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, Government of India
targetGroupText: Scheduled Castes, Denotified Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Tribes, landless agricultural labourers, traditional artisans
seatsPerYear: About 125 (no more than 10% from one state)
applicationWindow: Round 1 around March–April; Round 2 possible in September–October
coverage: Tuition fees | Yearly maintenance allowance | Contingency allowance | Visa fee | Airfare | Medical insurance
eligibility: Belongs to one of the target groups | Family income up to ₹8 lakh a year | Under 35 on 1 April of the selection year | Master's: at least 60% in the Bachelor's degree; PhD: at least 60% in the Master's degree | Admission to a foreign university
howToApply: Register on nosmsje.gov.in when the round opens | Fill in the online form and upload the caste certificate, income certificate, mark sheets, offer letter and passport | Submit before the closing date and keep the printed application
notes: Some sources give an age limit of 40 for PhD. Check the income limit and seat numbers in the year's guidelines.

name: National Overseas Scholarship for ST Students
offeredBy: Ministry of Tribal Affairs, Government of India
targetGroupText: Scheduled Tribes, including Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTG)
maxAmount: Full cost; maintenance about US$15,400 a year (USA) or £9,900 (UK)
coverage: Tuition fees | Maintenance allowance: about US$15,400 a year or £9,900 | Contingency allowance: about US$1,532 or £1,116 | Visa fee | Medical insurance | Airfare | Local travel
eligibility: Scheduled Tribe certificate | Family income up to ₹6 lakh a year | Admission to a university in the QS top 1,000
howToApply: Register on overseas.tribal.gov.in when applications open | Fill in the online form and upload the ST certificate, income certificate, mark sheets and offer letter | Submit before the deadline
notes: The ₹6 lakh income limit is the 2024 rule; check whether it still applies. The QS top 1,000 rule is from a recent report.

name: National Overseas Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
offeredBy: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD), Government of India
targetGroupText: Students with a disability listed in the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016
coverage: Full scholarship for study abroad (check the current guidelines for the items covered)
eligibility: A disability listed in the RPwD Act, 2016 | UDID card | Admission to a Master's or PhD course abroad
howToApply: Check with DEPwD whether to apply on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) or offline | Submit the application with the disability certificate, UDID card, mark sheets and offer letter
notes: Open to students with disabilities from any category, not only SC, ST or OBC.

name: Commonwealth Master's and PhD Scholarships (UK)
offeredBy: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission (UK); nominations by the Ministry of Education, Government of India
targetGroupText: All Indian citizens
maxAmount: Full cost of study in the UK
applicationWindow: Ministry notice around July; Commission deadline around mid-October
coverage: Tuition fees | Living allowance | Return airfare
eligibility: Indian citizen | Applying for a Master's or PhD course in the UK | Meets the academic rules in the year's Ministry of Education notice
howToApply: Apply on the Commonwealth Scholarship Commission's online system | Also apply on the Ministry of Education portal (both are required) | The Ministry shortlists and nominates candidates; the Commission makes the final selection
notes: Being nominated does not guarantee an award. Courses start in September or October of the following year.

name: Fulbright-Nehru Master's Fellowships (USA)
offeredBy: United States-India Educational Foundation (USIEF)
targetGroupText: Indian citizens with at least 3 years' work experience
coverage: J-1 visa support | Tuition and living costs | Return economy airfare | Accident and sickness cover
eligibility: Equivalent of a US Bachelor's degree with at least 55% marks | At least 3 years of full-time paid work after graduating | Not already holding, or enrolled in, a US degree | Not a central or state government employee
howToApply: Apply online on usief.org.in before the deadline | Shortlisted candidates are interviewed
notes: Dependents are not supported. USIEF notes the funding may not cover every cost.

name: Ambedkar Overseas Vidya Nidhi
offeredBy: Social Welfare Department, Government of Andhra Pradesh
targetGroupText: SC, ST, BC, Minority, EBC (including Kapu)
coverage: Financial assistance towards study abroad, at universities in 15 countries
eligibility: Native of Andhra Pradesh | From one of the target groups, with a caste certificate | Up to 35 on the date of the notification
howToApply: Apply on jnanabhumi.ap.gov.in when the new notification is published | Upload the caste certificate, income certificate, mark sheets and offer letter
notes: Being reintroduced. Undergraduate here means MBBS only. An older BC version gave ₹15 lakh; confirm the amount in the new notification.

name: Financial Assistance to SC Students for Higher Studies Abroad
offeredBy: Department for the Welfare of SC/ST/OBC/Minorities, Government of NCT of Delhi
targetGroupText: SC students who live in Delhi
coverage: Financial assistance for higher studies abroad
eligibility: SC student who lives in Delhi
howToApply: Contact the department for the current notification
notes: Listed for 2024-25; amount, seats and dates not confirmed.

name: Foreign Study Loan for SC Students
offeredBy: Social Justice & Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat
targetGroupText: Scheduled Caste students from Gujarat
coverage: Loan towards the cost of study abroad, at 4% simple interest
eligibility: Scheduled Caste student from Gujarat | Has passed HSC | No income limit specified
howToApply: Apply online on esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in

name: Loan for Foreign Study (SEBC/OBC)
offeredBy: Government of Gujarat
targetGroupText: SEBC / OBC students from Gujarat
coverage: Loan towards the cost of study abroad, at 4% interest
eligibility: SEBC/OBC student from Gujarat
howToApply: Apply online on esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in

name: Foreign Study Loan for Unreserved Students
offeredBy: Gujarat Unreserved Educational & Economic Development Corporation (GUEEDC)
targetGroupText: Unreserved (general) category students from Gujarat
coverage: Loan for medical and postgraduate courses abroad, at 4% simple interest | Repayment: 5 years for loans up to ₹5 lakh, 6 years above that
eligibility: Unreserved-category student from Gujarat | Applying for a medical or postgraduate course abroad
howToApply: Apply online on gueedc.gujarat.gov.in

name: Prabuddha Overseas Scholarship
offeredBy: Social Welfare Department, Government of Karnataka
targetGroupText: SC and ST students who are permanent residents of Karnataka
maxAmount: Up to 100% of costs, depending on family income
coverage: A share of study costs abroad that depends on family income (formerly 100% up to ₹8 lakh, then 50% or 33%)
eligibility: Permanent resident of Karnataka | SC or ST only | Admission to an overseas university
howToApply: Apply through the Karnataka Social Welfare Department portal when applications open
notes: PhD support was cancelled in October 2023 and later restored with conditions. Check the current conditions and income bands.

name: Unnathi Overseas Scholarship
offeredBy: SC/ST Development Departments, Government of Kerala
targetGroupText: SC and ST students from Kerala
applicationWindow: Early in the year (closed 31 March in 2025)
coverage: Tuition fees | Accommodation | Visa | Health insurance | Airfare
eligibility: Resident of Kerala | SC or ST | Admission to a Master's or PhD course abroad
howToApply: Apply through the Kerala SC/ST Development Department when the notification is published

name: Overseas Scholarship for OBC Students
offeredBy: Backward Classes Development Department (BCDD), Government of Kerala
targetGroupText: OBC students from Kerala
coverage: Partial funding towards study abroad
eligibility: OBC student from Kerala | PG or PhD in engineering, management, pure sciences, agriculture, medicine, law or social sciences
howToApply: Apply through the BCDD when the notification is published

name: Scholarship for Meritorious Students to Study Abroad
offeredBy: Higher Education Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh
targetGroupText: Meritorious students from Madhya Pradesh
coverage: Support for study abroad (check the notification for what is covered)
eligibility: Meritorious student from Madhya Pradesh | Admitted to a Master's or PhD course abroad
howToApply: Apply through the Higher Education Department when the notification is published

name: Rajarshi Shahu Maharaj Foreign Scholarship
offeredBy: Social Justice & Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra
targetGroupText: SC and Neo-Buddhist students from Maharashtra
coverage: Full funding for Master's or PhD study abroad
eligibility: Resident of Maharashtra | SC or Neo-Buddhist | Up to 35 years old | Unconditional offer from a university in the QS top 200 | Family income proof for the latest financial year (Tahsildar certificate, ITR or Form 16)
howToApply: Apply under the department's yearly notice on sjsa.maharashtra.gov.in
notes: No income limit was confirmed. The ₹8 lakh limit seen online belongs to a different, domestic scheme.

name: Maharaja Sayajirao Gaikwad SARTHI Scholarship
offeredBy: SARTHI, Government of Maharashtra
targetGroupText: Maratha and Kunbi students from Maharashtra
coverage: Full funding for Master's or PhD study abroad
eligibility: Maratha or Kunbi student from Maharashtra | Programme at a university in the QS top 200
howToApply: Apply under SARTHI's yearly notice
notes: Payments to 2025 students were reported as delayed.

name: Foreign Scholarship for OBC, VJNT and SBC Students
offeredBy: OBC Welfare Department, Government of Maharashtra
targetGroupText: OBC, Vimukta Jati and Nomadic Tribes (VJNT) and Special Backward Class (SBC) students from Maharashtra
coverage: Full funding for study abroad
eligibility: OBC, VJNT or SBC student from Maharashtra | Admitted to a Master's or PhD course abroad
howToApply: Apply under the department's notice

name: Overseas Scholarship for Minority Students
offeredBy: Minority Development Department, Government of Maharashtra
targetGroupText: Religious minority students from Maharashtra
coverage: Full financial assistance for study abroad
eligibility: Minority student from Maharashtra | Unconditional admission to a university in the QS top 200
howToApply: Apply under the department's yearly notice
notes: Only 24 students were funded in the first year (2024-25).

name: Videsh Siksha Bruti
offeredBy: ST & SC Development Department, Government of Odisha
targetGroupText: SC and ST students from Odisha
coverage: Study and living expenses abroad, up to ₹25 lakh a year
eligibility: SC or ST student from Odisha | Family income up to ₹12 lakh a year | Admission to a PG or PhD course abroad
howToApply: Apply under the department's notice

name: Overseas Scholarship for SC Students
offeredBy: Social Justice Department, Government of Punjab
targetGroupText: SC students and landless agricultural labourers from Punjab (30% of seats for women)
coverage: Tuition fees | Airfare | Visa fee | Maintenance: ₹13.17 lakh | Contingency: ₹1.35 lakh
eligibility: SC student, or from a landless agricultural labourer family, from Punjab
howToApply: For 2025-26, applications went online through nosmsje.gov.in; check the 2026-27 notice

name: Swami Vivekananda Scholarship for Academic Excellence
offeredBy: Higher Education Department, Government of Rajasthan
targetGroupText: Students from Rajasthan
coverage: Full funding for study abroad
eligibility: Student from Rajasthan | Admitted to a course at a foreign university
howToApply: Log in through RajSSO | Apply on the Rajasthan Higher Education portal
notes: Formerly the Rajiv Gandhi Scholarship for Academic Excellence (renamed March 2024). In August 2025 the opposition said overseas places were cut from 500 to 150.

name: Annal Ambedkar Overseas Higher Education Scholarship
offeredBy: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
targetGroupText: Adi Dravidar (SC), Adi Dravidar converted to Christianity, and ST students from Tamil Nadu
coverage: Study costs abroad, up to the maximum amount
eligibility: Tamil Nadu student from a target group | Family income under ₹8 lakh | Admission to a PG or PhD course abroad
howToApply: Register on tnadwscholarship.in with Aadhaar | Upload the community certificate, income certificate and university admission details
notes: Another source gives ₹10–30 lakh. Check the amount.

name: Ambedkar Overseas Vidya Nidhi
offeredBy: SC Development Department, Government of Telangana
targetGroupText: SC students from Telangana
coverage: Up to ₹20 lakh towards study abroad
eligibility: SC student from Telangana | Family income up to ₹5 lakh a year | Only one student per family
howToApply: Apply on the Telangana ePASS portal

name: Mahatma Jyotiba Phule Overseas Vidya Nidhi
offeredBy: BC Welfare Department, Government of Telangana
targetGroupText: BC and EBC students from Telangana
coverage: Up to ₹20 lakh | One-way economy ticket | Visa fees
eligibility: BC or EBC student from Telangana | Only one student per family
howToApply: Apply on the Telangana ePASS portal

name: Chief Minister's Overseas Scholarship for Minorities
offeredBy: Minorities Welfare Department, Government of Telangana
targetGroupText: Minority students from Telangana
coverage: Up to ₹20 lakh | One-way airfare: ₹60,000
eligibility: Minority student from Telangana | Family income up to ₹5 lakh a year | Only one student per family
howToApply: Apply on the Telangana ePASS portal in June

name: J.N. Tata Endowment for Higher Education
offeredBy: J.N. Tata Endowment
targetGroupText: All Indian citizens
coverage: Interest-free loan scholarship, repayable over 7 years | Up to ₹7.5 lakh may become a grant, depending on results abroad
eligibility: Indian citizen | Has an offer from a foreign university, or is waiting for offers
howToApply: Apply online on jntataendowment.org | Preliminary screening in March–April | Online aptitude test in early May | Subject interview in May–June | Final decisions in mid-July
notes: Students still waiting for offers must tell the Endowment as soon as they have a confirmed place.

name: Inlaks Shivdasani Scholarship
offeredBy: Inlaks Shivdasani Foundation
targetGroupText: Indian passport holders living in India
coverage: Funding for postgraduate study at top universities abroad
eligibility: Indian passport holder living in India | Under the age limit (born after 1 January 1994 for the 2024 cycle)
howToApply: Apply online when the cycle opens

name: K.C. Mahindra Scholarships for Post-Graduate Studies Abroad
offeredBy: K.C. Mahindra Education Trust
targetGroupText: Indian citizens with a first-class degree
coverage: Interest-free loan scholarship for postgraduate study abroad
eligibility: Indian citizen | First-class degree or equivalent diploma
howToApply: Apply online when the cycle opens
